summary: BunkerWeb functions as a web application firewall designed to protect HTTP-based services from common cyber attacks. It integrates into your infrastructure to inspect traffic before it reaches your backend applications.
goodFor: Self-hosters who need an additional security layer in front of their web services and prefer open-source perimeter defence.
watchOut: Configuring a WAF often introduces complexity regarding false positives, which can block legitimate traffic unless tuned carefully.
deployNotes: It typically runs via containers like Docker or Kubernetes, requiring persistent storage for logs and configuration data alongside an appropriate reverse proxy setup.
